agent_activity.units: fixture tokens and milliseconds; no monetary cost

overview_history.basis: Seven daily summary samples. Each completed run has a paired direct-source comparison for the same checks and outcome. Errors are excluded from both cost paths. Each modeled run includes preparation once. No live usage was collected.

aggregate_comparison.basis: Five paired scenario runs; each pair uses the same controls, release scope, and qualification success criteria. Aggregate elapsed is the sum of run spans plus preparation, excluding gaps between scenarios.

assumptions: All activity, token, and time values are illustrative fixture values, not measurements or benchmark results.
The paired baseline is simulated raw-source work for the same scenario and success criteria.
Elapsed time is the span from earliest start to latest end, so parallel calls are not added together; work time is summed.
Each selected scenario comparison includes one-time model preparation for a cold run; the five-scenario aggregate includes preparation once total. Retries and cache savings are not modeled.
Qualification results come from the shared product ship evaluator for this scenario and evidence scope.

notes: Synthetic broker replay; no external system was queried.
The policy tree is descriptive input for this demonstration; native hierarchy enforcement is not claimed.
Controls are proposed examples and do not assert legal or compliance certification.
The nine integration entries are logical source-domain instances of one hosted collector program.
